mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{hash}, must_change_password = false WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_login_attempt (username, ip, success, attempted_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{ip}, #{success}, #{attemptedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM sys_login_attempt WHERE username = #{username} AND success = false AND attempted_at > now() - make_interval(mins => #{minutes})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_refresh_token (user_id, jti, expires_at, revoked, user_agent, ip, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{jti}, #{expiresAt}, #{revoked}, #{userAgent}, #{ip}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_refresh_token SET revoked = true WHERE jti = #{jti}
UPDATE sys_refresh_token SET revoked = true WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked = false
